verdict.rationale: Steel documents a Files API endpoint for managing files on Steel sessions (steel-docs-16), plus agent traces that can be downloaded as JSON/ZIP/markdown artifacts (steel-docs-7), suggesting some upload/download and artifact retrieval capability. However, there's no detailed documentation of the file upload/download workflow itself (e.g., how an agent uploads a file to a site form or downloads a file from a page and retrieves it via API), no code examples, and no independent verification of this working end-to-end. missing for 10: detailed docs/examples of agent-initiated file upload to sites and file download from sites, confirmation of artifact retrieval workflow, independent/hands-on corroboration.
